title: Pauper · mtg-kernel
summary: Eight Pauper decks on the mtg-kernel rules engine; every matchup plays each deck in both seats. Protocol v1 ratings, not audited for hidden information. Halted games are unrated; they come from builtin bots taking goad or menace choices that the engine offers but the rules forbid. The mtg-kernel engine build and the model checkpoints are private: the published ledgers, bot ids and hashes let anyone re-derive the ratings, but not replay the games.
